info.title: Sentiment Active Learning API
info.description:
REST API for the Sentiment Active Learning application.

Exposes endpoints to:
- Submit movie reviews for sentiment classification (POSITIVE / NEGATIVE).
- Manage labelled review samples used for model training.
- Trigger training runs and query model performance statistics.
- Monitor the active-learning cycle driven by the Claude AI oracle.

All error responses use a uniform JSON envelope: httpStatus, httpStatusText, errorCode, message.

tags.name: Model
tags.description: Manage model training runs, query model health statistics, and monitor the active-learning cycle.

tags.name: Reviews
tags.description: Submit movie reviews for sentiment classification, manage labelled samples, and provide human feedback to the active-learning pipeline.

get.description: Returns every review sample in the system, regardless of labelling status.

post.description: Persists the review, classifies it using the trained Naive Bayes model, and consults the Claude AI oracle if the model is uncertain. Returns the assigned sentiment label, confidence score, and label source.

value.message: Review text must not be blank
Review text must not exceed 5000 characters
A review sample with the same text already exists.
The model has not been trained yet. Please submit labelled samples and trigger a training run first.
Claude API call failed: connection timed out.
Claude returned an unrecognised sentiment label: 'Neutral'. Expected POSITIVE or NEGATIVE.

post.description: Corrects a wrong model prediction. The corrected label is stored with source MANUAL and feeds into the next retraining cycle. An optional feedback note is logged for diagnostics.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The database identifier of the misclassified review.

value.message: Corrected label must not be null. Accepted values: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE
Feedback note must not exceed 500 characters
Review sample with ID 42 was not found.

post.description: Trains the Naive Bayes model on all currently labelled review samples, evaluates it on a hold-out set, hot-swaps the live model, and saves the result to disk. An empty request body is accepted — defaults apply (forceRetrain=false, no note).

value.message: Insufficient labelled samples for training. Required: 20, available: 5. Submit more labelled reviews or set forceRetrain=true.

patch.description: Assigns a POSITIVE or NEGATIVE label to the specified review sample. The label is stored with source MANUAL and overrides any existing label.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The database identifier of the review sample.

get.description: Returns only review samples that are still awaiting a label — either pending manual input or queued for Claude oracle labelling.
Returns only review samples that have been assigned a sentiment label — by seed data, manual input, or Claude oracle.

Returns a snapshot combining live corpus counts from the database with historical evaluation metrics from the most recent training run. If the model has not been trained yet, historical metrics are zero.

ReviewRequest.description: Request body for submitting a movie review for classification or labelling.

reviewText.description: The raw text of the movie review to classify or label.
reviewText.example: An absolute masterpiece. The performances were outstanding and the storyline kept me gripped from start to finish.

ApiErrorResponse.description: Error envelope returned for all non-2xx API responses.

httpStatusText.description: Standard HTTP reason phrase for the status code.

message.description: Human-readable error description. May include dynamic context.
message.example: Review sample with ID 42 was not found.

ClassifyResponse.description: Result of a sentiment classification operation.

id.description: Identifier of the classified review sample.

reviewText.description: The review text that was submitted for classification.
reviewText.example: An absolute masterpiece. The performances were outstanding.

label.description: The assigned sentiment label. Null if classification is pending.

labelSource.description: Who assigned the label: SEED, MANUAL, or CLAUDE. Null if pending.

confidenceScore.description: Model confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0. Below the uncertainty threshold the oracle is consulted.

uncertain.description: True if the model was uncertain and the Claude oracle was consulted.

PredictionFeedbackRequest.description: Request body for submitting a human correction to a model prediction.

correctedLabel.description: The correct sentiment label as determined by the human operator.

feedbackNote.description: Optional note explaining why the model prediction was wrong. Logged for diagnostics. Not persisted. Max 500 characters.
feedbackNote.example: The model missed the sarcastic tone — this is clearly a negative review despite the positive vocabulary.

ReviewSampleResponse.description: A single review sample as stored in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier of the review sample.

reviewText.description: The raw text of the movie review.
reviewText.example: An absolute masterpiece. The performances were outstanding.

label.description: The assigned sentiment label. Null if not yet labelled.

labelSource.description: The origin of the label: SEED, MANUAL, or CLAUDE. Null if not yet labelled.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the review sample was first created. System-managed.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the review sample was last updated. System-managed.

TrainingRequest.description: Request body for triggering a manual model training run.

forceRetrain.description: If true, bypasses the minimum sample threshold and forces training immediately. Use with caution — may produce an unreliable model on small datasets.

note.description: Optional human-readable note describing why this training run was triggered. Logged for audit purposes. Not persisted.
note.example: Manual retrain after bulk seed data import.

TrainingResponse.description: Result of a completed model training run.

trainedAt.description: Timestamp when the training run completed.

samplesUsed.description: Total labelled samples used in this training run.

accuracyScore.description: Model accuracy on the hold-out evaluation set. Between 0.0 and 1.0.

precisionScore.description: Model precision on the hold-out set. Between 0.0 and 1.0.

recallScore.description: Model recall on the hold-out set. Between 0.0 and 1.0.

modelSavedToDisk.description: True if the model was successfully serialised to disk after training.

modelStoragePath.description: Path where the model was saved. Null if serialisation failed.

note.description: The audit note from the original training request, if provided.
note.example: Manual retrain after bulk seed data import.

LabelRequest.description: Request body for manually assigning a sentiment label to a review sample.

label.description: The sentiment label to assign. Must be POSITIVE or NEGATIVE.

ModelStatsResponse.description: Snapshot of the trained model health and training corpus statistics.

trained.description: True if a trained model is available for classification.

lastTrainedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent training run. Null if never trained.

samplesUsedInLastRun.description: Number of labelled samples used in the most recent training run.

totalLabelled.description: Total labelled samples currently in the database.

seedLabelledCount.description: Number of samples labelled from seed data.

manualLabelledCount.description: Number of samples labelled manually via the API.

claudeLabelledCount.description: Number of samples labelled by the Claude AI oracle.

accuracyLastRun.description: Model accuracy on the hold-out set during the last training run. Between 0.0 and 1.0. Zero if never evaluated.

retrainBatchSize.description: Configured number of new Claude-labelled samples that trigger a retrain.

retrainBatchProgress.description: New Claude-labelled samples since last retrain. When equal to retrainBatchSize, a retrain is triggered.

ActiveLearningStatusResponse.description: Snapshot of the active-learning cycle state and health.

cycleActive.description: True if the active-learning cycle is operational and the model is trained and available.

totalRetrainingRuns.description: Total number of completed retraining runs since first startup.

lastRetrainedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent retraining run. Null if never retrained.

claudeLabelledSinceLastRetrain.description: New Claude-labelled samples since the last retraining run. Resets to zero after each retrain.

retrainBatchSize.description: Configured batch size threshold that triggers an automatic retrain.

progressPercent.description: Progress towards next automatic retrain, between 0 and 100.

totalUnlabelled.description: Total review samples currently awaiting labelling.

modelStoragePath.description: Configured path where the serialised model file is stored.

modelFileExists.description: True if a serialised model file exists at the configured storage path.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic credentials for Swagger UI access. Configured via SWAGGER_USERNAME / SWAGGER_PASSWORD environment variables in production.
